name: Google Apps Script MCP Server
description: Enables comprehensive management of Google Apps Script projects, including project creation, file operations, and web app deployments. It features a security-first design with encrypted property management and automated security auditing for GAS environments.

rawRecord.description: Enables comprehensive management of Google Apps Script projects, including project creation, file operations, and web app deployments. It features a security-first design with encrypted property management and automated security auditing for GAS environments.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Hex encryption key (32 bytes / 64 characters hex string recommended) for securing script properties. If not provided, one may be automatically generated.

MCP_SERVER_NAME.description: The name identifier for the MCP server.

GOOGLE_AUTH_CODE.description: OAuth2 authorization code for initial authentication.

GOOGLE_CREDENTIALS_PATH.description: Path to the OAuth2 credentials.json file.

GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY.description: Service Account key as a JSON string or a file path to the service-account-key.json.
